**Connect Power BI semantic model to Plotly Studio (Password and Username)**

Start a new project on Plotly Studio and insert this prompt, replacing the sections highlighted in yellow with your own respective names. If Plotly Studio responds to the prompt by asking about a service principal or suggesting other connection methods, remind it that it only needs a username, password and tenant ID. Tell it again that there is no need for a Power Bi service principal or an app registration.

*Connect to PowerBi services and the “Flights” semantic model in the “test-workspace-1”. Get data from the “Flights” table.*

*For credentials, use only the Power BI username and password and the workspace's tenant ID. Authenticates against my tenant using the tenant ID. Do not use a Client ID or Client secret. There is no need for a Power Bi service principal or an app registration.*

*Try this as scope: [https://analysis.windows.net/powerbi/api/.default](https://analysis.windows.net/powerbi/api/.default) \- not [https://api.powerbi.com](https://api.powerbi.com)*

*Include comprehensive error handling and diagnostic reporting in the code.*

*Do not try to use or install the azure library.*

*End of prompt.*
